title: [checklists] If the next feature release's EOM release is *this* bugfix release, don't create stub release notes
author: jacobtylerwalls

title: Add django-storages support and media to S3
author: tobiasmcnulty
body_preview: Uploaded media and Django releases are currently stored directly on the server's file system. We can migrate it to S3 to simplify the migration steps when replacing the production server. Note: Trac configuration and attachments would still be stored on the file system, so this would not eliminate the manual file copying altogether.

title: [checklists] CVE record generator: support multiple credits entries per role
author: nessita
body_preview: The generator emits one credits entry per role, packing multiple people into a single value string. `credits` is an array in CVE 5.1, so each person should get their own entry with the appropriate type, allowing downstream consumers to attribute individually. Needs a way to express a list of names per role in the input metadata.
